response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior full-stack engineer with strong testing/craftsmanship credentials and some high-throughput, low-latency backend exposure (Sociomantic/Dunnhumby), but the core hard requirement of 8 years of C++ is not met — C++ appears in roughly 7 months at National Instruments and a university thesis project. His large-scale infrastructure experience is limited and mostly in D/Node.js microservices rather than cloud compute platform, storage, or hardware architecture work, and he has no documented formal technical leadership role owning strategy or mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers. The teaching, workshop, and open-source founder background shows mentoring aptitude, but the profile is a web/product engineer rather than a systems/cloud-platform lead.
strengths: Broad, long-tenured engineering career across web, mobile, embedded, and backend
Real low-latency, high-volume microservices experience (millions of req/sec) at Sociomantic
Strong mentoring signal: workshops, courses, conference talks, open-source project founder
concerns: Far short of the 8-year C++ requirement (~1 year of documented C++ work)
No formal technical leadership or platform-strategy ownership role
Little cloud compute platform, distributed systems architecture, or hardware/storage depth

key_factors.factor: High-throughput backend and mentoring track record
